provenance.method: source-reconstructed native RTL bench occupancy from each shot actual cycle counter plus exact fixed protocol/rearm; not full per-shot timestamps
provenance.source_proof: All GROW/MERGE/PEELING variable waits are counted. Fixed 52-byte driver ingress to final accept is 102.5 cycles; final accept to first response is counter+3; 263 response bytes take262cycles fromfirst tolast; conservative rearm9.5cycles. Ten208bitresultwords fit effective31wordFIFO; outputalwaysready. Frozen age10000cycle timeout excludes hidden16bitcounterwrap.

failure_definition: final measured parity XOR produced correction (identity if dropped) differs from expected zero; all shots retained
interval_policy: no IID confidence interval on timing-selected outcomes; zero observations remain zero

profile.admission: Immediate whole-shot drop when no eligible idle instance; no queue, no completion deadline. Complete independent shots may use any identical instance; no streaming state is migrated.
profile.resource_evidence: Same resource-fit projection as the prior V80 capacity profile. Reference hierarchy footprints predate the SI1000 finite-memory variant. This is not demonstrated ten-slot placement or a measured footprint of the adapted RTL.
profile.timing_scope: Identical input-dependent native RTL instance occupancy for Static and QShell, supplied per shot with provenance. Complete independent window requests; conservative non-overlap. Shell, adapter, network and shared interconnect timing are excluded, not measured as zero. Ideal capacity removes all processing delay while retaining actual Helios correction predictions.

service_statistics: native/occupancy times include conservative rearm; processed times end at complete correction response; ideal effective times are zero
timing_method: source-reconstructed native RTL bench occupancy from each shot actual cycle counter plus exact fixed protocol/rearm; not full per-shot timestamps
unit: independent nine-round single-logical-qubit shot; not round-record loss or any-of-64-qubits failure
